title: Isolated best-of-2 implementation streams for evolve cycles
mechanism: For a chosen proposal, run two independent Codex implementation streams in separate worktrees with no shared task memory (private CHITTA_DB_PATH, hooks in headless mode), gate both, and let the orchestrator merge the better candidate; compare against the current single shared-memory stream on accepted-bet rate and measured delta

expected_gain.rationale: SwarmWorld: isolated best-of-N search retained the strongest single artifact (0.3488 vs 0.2380 under shared culture) while shared societies won on breadth; an evolve cycle wants the single best patch, so isolated candidates may beat one memory-fed stream

evidence.claim: isolated control retained the strongest final single artifact, 0.3488 versus 0.2380 under full culture (3,200 ticks, N=100)
shared worlds produced 5.75 and 7.00 validated inventions versus 2.75 in isolated search, so the advantage of sharing is breadth, not the best artifact
